claim: Let \(\mathcal H=\bigoplus_{i=1}^{K}(\mathcal H_{A_i}\otimes\mathcal H_{B_i})\) with \(d_i=\dim\mathcal H_{A_i}\ge1\) and \(m_i=\dim\mathcal H_{B_i}\ge1\), and let \(\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{i=1}^{K}(\mathcal B(\mathcal H_{A_i})\otimes I_{B_i})\). Write \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal A}\) for the trace-preserving Hilbert--Schmidt conditional expectation onto this algebra, and let \(\mathcal E_p(\rho)=(1-p)\rho\oplus p\,\operatorname{Tr}(\rho)|e\rangle\langle e|\), \(0\le p\le1\), be the standard flagged erasure channel on \(\mathcal H\). Then the exact Bény reconstruction error is \[\boxed{\epsilon_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal E_p):=\inf_{\mathcal R}\|\mathcal R\circ\mathcal E_p-\mathcal P_{\mathcal A}\|_\diamond=2p\left(1-\frac1S\right),\qquad S:=\sum_{i=1}^{K}d_i^2=\dim_{\mathbb C}\mathcal A.}\] An optimal recovery applies \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal A}\) on the unerased branch and, on the erasure flag, prepares \[\sigma_\star=\bigoplus_{i=1}^{K}\frac{d_i^2}{S}\left(\frac{I_{A_i}}{d_i}\otimes\frac{I_{B_i}}{m_i}\right).\] Thus the worst-case erasure reconstruction cost depends only on the protected algebra dimension \(S\), not on the gauge multiplicities \(m_i\). For a \(K\)-level classical memory it becomes \(2p(1-1/K)\), while for a \(d\)-dimensional fully quantum memory it becomes \(2p(1-1/d^2)\). If \(\lambda=(d_1,\ldots,d_K)\) is Kuperberg's hybrid-memory shape, then \(S=\|\lambda\|_2^2\), so the same invariant that controls the shape's \(2\)-norm also fixes this exact single-shot diamond-norm erasure radius.

critical_steps: Complete positivity of \(X\mapsto d\operatorname{Tr}(X)I-X\) gives a reference-stable upper bound.
A sector maximally entangled witness gives the matching lower bound.
Flagged erasure scales the sharp complete-erasure radius by \(p\).
claim_to_evidence.domain: All finite direct-sum matrix algebras with positive sector and multiplicity dimensions and all \(0\le p\le1\).
claim_to_evidence.unproved_limits: No infinite-dimensional, selective-erasure, or energy-constrained claim.

title: Exact erasure reconstruction radius for finite hybrid quantum-classical algebras
